change: Added public ReadOnlyWorldSession for a fresh saved-world snapshot. One worker validates/spools the entire file; owner poll builds a partial World/scene without materializing complete World geometry. Initial and replacement startup share a staged builder: all World/binding/pump/scene/journal/session allocation and guards precede one-time metadata consumption. Failed guard leaves metadata retryable. Cold startup rejects pending overlays. The public owner-fenced API exposes checked-row progress, completed CPU/GPU/failed-chunk counts, demand/tick/upload, per-chunk failure, read-only World and explicit cleanup. It exposes no LocalGame, save or edit capability. Unknown/unmeshed cells stay loading boundaries; status READY means descriptor only. Model-map or external World mutation invalidates a session; independent sessions retain separate maps and captured file geometry.

Opening validates the whole file on the worker; owner metadata/scene staging and existing cleanup have no frame-time guarantee.

playtest: Playtest: actual Java/GLFW/OpenGL integration CLI on inherited DISPLAY with isolated synthetic offline v10 sources. Expected the public API to reopen the saved world without a complete resident replay, stage only the requested chunk, preserve CPU-versus-GPU readiness and unknown-cell/edit/capture gates, render saved later coloured geometry/model definitions, leave source bytes unchanged and close all owned resources. Observed one CPU and GPU-ready chunk, zero resident World chunks, unknown-cell reads and edits/capture rejected, coloured framebuffer rendered through the public World, unchanged saved bytes and full scratch/Mesh cleanup. Opening, cancellation/retry, metadata once-only transfer, owner/reentry/revision/budget/overlay rejection, failed chunk visibility, independent model maps, file-replacement snapshot, invalid source and real failed-cleanup explicit retry cases passed. Existing two owner-slot installs, latest-tail/prefix/model-counter/source-sky, old-World retirement, ordinary/pending geometry, lighting/roof-clear sky, planar/model/water and final resource-baseline regressions also passed. Browser testing does not apply to this native engine integration. Main was not rerun: its complete-replay gameplay gate is unchanged and this API is not wired into Main. OS caches were not controlled; no required cold-cache timing budget is qualified.
